RUS_education_reform_start = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_completed_focus = RUS_future_domestic_205 }
		RUS_education_initialize = yes
	}
}

	add_to_variable = { RUS_basic_education_level = RUS_edu_external_basic_gain }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_higher_education_level = RUS_edu_external_higher_gain }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm = RUS_edu_external_heat_change }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm > 75 } }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_overheat_days = 1 }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { RUS_education_overheat_days = 0 } }
	RUS_education_refresh = yes
}


RUS_education_begin_literacy = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_literacy } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_literacy } check_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count < RUS_edu_slots } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_basic }  }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_literacy
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_literacy = 90 }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_basic
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 3 }
		}
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_tick_literacy = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_literacy check_variable = { RUS_edu_days_literacy > 0 } }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = 0.0555555555556 }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_quality }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_basic_multiplier }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_basic_education_level = RUS_edu_gain }
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_days_literacy = 1 }
	}
}


RUS_education_cancel_literacy = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_literacy }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_literacy
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_basic
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 3 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 3 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 3 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_literacy = 0 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_literacy days = 90 }
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_finish_literacy = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_literacy }

	}

	if = {

		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_technical
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_technical = 90 }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_technical
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 10 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 10 }
		}
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}

RUS_education_tick_technical = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_technical check_variable = { RUS_edu_days_technical > 0 } }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = 0.0111111111111 }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_quality }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_basic_multiplier }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_basic_education_level = RUS_edu_gain }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = 0.0222222222222 }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_quality }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_higher_multiplier }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_higher_education_level = RUS_edu_gain }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = 0.0333333333333 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_central }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = 1.25 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm = RUS_edu_heat_gain }
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_days_technical = 1 }
	}
}

		}
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_tick_library = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_library check_variable = { RUS_edu_days_library > 0 } }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = 0.0166666666667 }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_quality }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_basic_multiplier }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_basic_education_level = RUS_edu_gain }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = 0.00833333333333 }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_quality }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_higher_multiplier }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_higher_education_level = RUS_edu_gain }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = 0.0333333333333 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_central }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = 1.25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_amateur }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = 0.75 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm = RUS_edu_heat_gain }
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_days_library = 1 }
	}
}


RUS_education_cancel_library = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_library }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_library
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_culture
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 16 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 16 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 16 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_library = 0 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_library days = 90 }
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_finish_library = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_library }
		RUS_education_tick_library = yes
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_completed_activities = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_research_speed_factor = 0.002 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_stability_factor = 0.005 }
		RUS_education_cancel_library = yes
	}
}

		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_days_harvest_battle = 1 }
	}
}

		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_harvest_battle
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_technical

			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 0 }
		}
		if = {

RUS_education_finish_harvest_battle = {

		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_harvest_battle }
		RUS_education_tick_harvest_battle = yes
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_completed_activities = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_industrial_capacity_factory = 0.005 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_stability_factor = 0.005 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_nat_enabled NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_nat_system_closed } }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_stock = 3 }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_stock < 0 } } set_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_stock = 0 } }
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_stock > 12 } } set_variable = { RUS_nat_rye_stock = 12 } }
			RUS_nat_refresh = yes
		}
		RUS_education_cancel_harvest_battle = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_begin_vigilance = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_vigilance } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_vigilance } check_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count < RUS_edu_slots } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_culture } has_country_flag = RUS_edu_culture_open }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_vigilance
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_vigilance = 90 }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_culture
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 41 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 41 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 41 }
		}
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_tick_vigilance = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_vigilance check_variable = { RUS_edu_days_vigilance > 0 } }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = 0.0111111111111 }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_quality }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_basic_multiplier }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_basic_education_level = RUS_edu_gain }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = 0.0333333333333 }
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_central }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = 1.25 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_amateur }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = 0.75 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm = RUS_edu_heat_gain }
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_days_vigilance = 1 }
	}
}

		RUS_education_tick_beloved_motherland = yes
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_completed_activities = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_stability_factor = 0.01 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_political_power_factor = 0.005 }
		RUS_education_cancel_beloved_motherland = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_begin_long_live_peace = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_long_live_peace } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_long_live_peace } check_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count < RUS_edu_slots } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_culture } has_country_flag = RUS_edu_culture_open has_completed_focus = RUS_future_foreign_005 }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_long_live_peace
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_long_live_peace = 120 }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_culture
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 53 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 53 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 0 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 53 }
		}
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_tick_long_live_peace = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_long_live_peace check_variable = { RUS_edu_days_long_live_peace > 0 } }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = 0.00833333333333 }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_quality }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_basic_multiplier }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_basic_education_level = RUS_edu_gain }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = 0.0166666666667 }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_quality }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_edu_gain = RUS_edu_higher_multiplier }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_higher_education_level = RUS_edu_gain }
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_heat_gain = -0.0333333333333 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm = RUS_edu_heat_gain }
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_days_long_live_peace = 1 }
	}
}


RUS_education_cancel_long_live_peace = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_long_live_peace }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_long_live_peace
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_busy_culture
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_edu_active_count = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 53 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_1 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 53 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_2 = 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 53 } }
			set_variable = { RUS_edu_slot_3 = 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_long_live_peace = 0 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_long_live_peace days = 90 }
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_finish_long_live_peace = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_long_live_peace }
		RUS_education_tick_long_live_peace = yes
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_completed_activities = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_stability_factor = 0.01 }
		RUS_education_cancel_long_live_peace = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_begin_listen = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_listen } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_listen } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_control_busy } }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_listen
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_listen = 30 }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_control_busy
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_cancel_listen = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_listen }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_listen
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_control_busy
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_listen = 0 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_listen days = 60 }
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_finish_listen = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_listen }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm = 10 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_political_power_cost = -0.005 }
		RUS_education_cancel_listen = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_begin_restore_order = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_restore_order } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_restore_order } NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_control_busy } }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_restore_order
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_restore_order = 30 }
		set_country_flag = RUS_edu_control_busy
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_cancel_restore_order = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_restore_order }
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_restore_order
		clr_country_flag = RUS_edu_control_busy
		set_variable = { RUS_edu_days_restore_order = 0 }
		set_country_flag = { flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_restore_order days = 60 }
		RUS_education_refresh = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_finish_restore_order = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_running_restore_order }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm = -12 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_edu_permanent_political_power_cost = -0.005 }
		RUS_education_cancel_restore_order = yes
	}
}


RUS_education_reform_effect_new_culture_popularisation = {
	custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_edu_legacy_new_culture_popularisation_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_basic_education_level = 2 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_higher_education_level = 0 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm = 3 }
			RUS_education_refresh = yes
		}
	}
}

	}
}
